show_claude.label: Show Claude
show_claude.description: 5-hour and weekly limits of your Claude plan.

show_codex.label: Show Codex
show_codex.description: All rate-limit windows reported by your Codex plan.

show_antigravity.label: Show Antigravity
show_antigravity.description: Gemini and third-party 5-hour and weekly quotas from AGY.

show_opencode.label: Show OpenCode Go
show_opencode.description: The 5-hour, weekly and monthly limits of your OpenCode Go plan.

show_spend.label: Show credit spend
show_spend.description: Add extra-usage spending to Claude, when credits are enabled on the account.

bar_style.label: Bar style
bar_style.description: How much of the bar the widget takes. Automatic uses the compact style on narrow and portrait monitors.

compact_below.label: Compact below (px)
compact_below.description: Monitors narrower than this get the compact style when the bar style is automatic.

refresh_seconds.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
refresh_seconds.description: How often to re-read usage in the background. Codex is read every 5 minutes at most. Opening the panel always asks for fresh numbers.

warn_at.label: Warn at (%)
warn_at.description: Percentage at which a number turns amber.

warn_color.label: Warning color
warn_color.description: Color for percentages past the warning threshold. Themes disagree on which accent means caution, so this one is fixed rather than a palette role.

alert_at.label: Alert at (%)
alert_at.description: Percentage at which a number turns red.
